name: traveler-v1
chrf_floor_note: Calibrated from the NEU-61 kickoff sweep: measured corpus chrF 83.2 on the published v2.0.0 pack; floor = max(15.0, min(0.45 * chrF, chrF - 20)). A direction-mislabeled pack collapses far below this value (see the es-en adversarial control).

entries.source: I need 3 tickets for tomorrow morning.
entries.reference: Preciso de 3 bilhetes para amanhã de manhã.

entries.source: There are 5 of us, including 2 children.
entries.reference: Somos 5 pessoas, incluindo 2 crianças.

entries.source: My phone number is 0044 7788 123456.
entries.reference: O meu número de telefone é 0044 7788 123456.

entries.source: The flight takes 9 hours and 25 minutes.
entries.reference: O voo demora 9 horas e 25 minutos.

entries.source: We are 4 people and we have 6 suitcases.
entries.reference: Somos 4 pessoas e temos 6 malas.

entries.source: Room 214 is on the second floor.
entries.reference: O quarto 214 fica no segundo andar.

entries.source: I arrived on October 3 and I leave on October 9.
entries.reference: Cheguei a 3 de outubro e parto a 9 de outubro.

entries.source: What time does the museum open on Sundays?
entries.reference: A que horas abre o museu aos domingos?

entries.source: My train leaves at 18:45 from platform 7.
entries.reference: O meu comboio parte às 18:45 da plataforma 7.

entries.source: The last bus leaves at 23:30 tonight.
entries.reference: O último autocarro parte às 23:30 esta noite.

entries.source: I have a reservation at 8 pm for 2 people.
entries.reference: Tenho uma reserva às 20h para 2 pessoas.

entries.source: Does the pharmacy open before 9 in the morning?
entries.reference: A farmácia abre antes das 9 da manhã?

entries.source: The tour starts at 14:15 and lasts 3 hours.
entries.reference: A visita começa às 14:15 e dura 3 horas.

entries.source: Breakfast is served from 6:30 to 10:00.
entries.reference: O pequeno-almoço é servido das 6:30 às 10:00.

entries.source: How much is a double room for 3 nights?
entries.reference: Quanto custa um quarto duplo para 3 noites?

entries.source: This costs 45 euros, including tax.
entries.reference: Isto custa 45 euros, incluindo impostos.

entries.source: Is there a discount for 2 adults and 1 child?
entries.reference: Há desconto para 2 adultos e 1 criança?

entries.source: The ticket costs 12.50 euros per person.
entries.reference: O bilhete custa 12,50 euros por pessoa.

entries.source: Can I pay the 78 euros by card?
entries.reference: Posso pagar os 78 euros com cartão?

entries.source: How much is the airport shuttle for 2 people?
entries.reference: Quanto custa o autocarro do aeroporto para 2 pessoas?

entries.source: The menu of the day is 15 euros with a drink included.
entries.reference: O menu do dia custa 15 euros com bebida incluída.

entries.source: The address is Calle Mayor 15, third floor.
entries.reference: A morada é Calle Mayor 15, terceiro andar.

entries.source: My hotel is at 28 Gran Vía, near the metro.
entries.reference: O meu hotel fica na Gran Vía 28, perto do metro.

entries.source: The embassy is at Paseo de la Castellana 259.
entries.reference: A embaixada fica no Paseo de la Castellana 259.

entries.source: Please write down the address: number 42, apartment 5B.
entries.reference: Por favor, anote a morada: número 42, apartamento 5B.

entries.source: The meeting point is Plaza del Sol, gate 3.
entries.reference: O ponto de encontro é a Plaza del Sol, porta 3.

entries.source: Is this the way to Carrer de Balmes 112?
entries.reference: É este o caminho para Carrer de Balmes 112?

entries.source: Where is the nearest bus stop?
entries.reference: Onde fica a paragem de autocarro mais próxima?

entries.source: Turn left at the traffic lights, then go straight for 200 meters.
entries.reference: Vire à esquerda no semáforo e depois siga em frente 200 metros.

entries.source: Is the station within walking distance of the hotel?
entries.reference: É possível ir a pé da estação para o hotel?

entries.source: Which line goes to the airport, line 5 or line 8?
entries.reference: Qual linha vai para o aeroporto, a linha 5 ou a linha 8?

entries.source: Excuse me, is this seat 14A?
entries.reference: Desculpe, este é o lugar 14A?

entries.source: How do I get to the old town from here?
entries.reference: Como chego à cidade velha daqui?

entries.source: The museum is about 15 minutes on foot from the square.
entries.reference: O museu fica a cerca de 15 minutos a pé da praça.

entries.source: Please call an ambulance, someone is unconscious.
entries.reference: Por favor, chame uma ambulância, alguém está inconsciente.

entries.source: I have lost my passport and my wallet.
entries.reference: Perdi o meu passaporte e a minha carteira.

entries.source: Where is the nearest hospital or clinic?
entries.reference: Onde fica o hospital ou a clínica mais próxima?

entries.source: I am allergic to peanuts; does this dish contain any?
entries.reference: Sou alérgico a amendoim; este prato contém algum?

entries.source: Someone stole my bag with 200 euros inside.
entries.reference: Alguém roubou a minha bolsa com 200 euros dentro.

entries.source: Call the police, please. There has been an accident.
entries.reference: Chame a polícia, por favor. Houve um acidente.
